note: CURATED. Every figure below is researched against a specific real car (see basedOn/sourceNote per entry) rather than estimated. Names are original, thinly veiled: a game about an unsanctioned race will not be licensed by any manufacturer. basedOn/sourceNote are provenance for us, not shown to players. Two entries (the ambulance, the dually) are flagged explicitly as partly estimated — a coachbuilt ambulance conversion and a one-ton dually have no published factory spec sheet for the figures we need, and we are not presenting an estimate as a found fact. What each car DOES with these numbers is derived in scripts/lib/cars.mjs, which is modelled and labelled as such.

categories.executive: Executive autocruisers — the meta picks. Huge top speed, big boots for auxiliary tanks, and styling that vanishes into traffic.
categories.poster: Poster supercars — unbeatable top end, maximum police attention, small tanks and fragile nerves.
categories.camouflage: Camouflaged utilities — trade aerodynamics for hiding in plain sight, or for actively deceiving enforcement.
categories.tuner: Tuner platforms — the baselines people build endless-highway cars out of.
categories.wildcard: Alternative-tech wildcards — a huge advantage in one place bought with a huge cost somewhere else.

cars.name: Nordstern Kurier 63
cars.sourceNote: EPA 18 mpg combined -> L/100km; DIN weight 1880kg + 75kg driver; 250 km/h stock, 300 with the derestrict package.
cars.notes: Peak twin-turbo V8 era, legendary for real-world cross-country blitzes.

cars.name: Vierring Sechs S
cars.sourceNote: auto-data.net / encycarpedia combined figures (9.2-9.4 L/100km, averaged); factory-limited to 250.
cars.notes: The exact generation used in real-world stealth and 'police disguise' runs.

cars.name: Weissblau M540 Competition
cars.sourceNote: carfolio/encycarpedia combined WLTP figure; 250 km/h stock, 305 with the M Driver's Package.
cars.notes: All-wheel drive and long-stint composure. Smallest tank of the four.

cars.name: Zuffen Panorama Turbo S
cars.sourceNote: 23.7 gal tank; Porsche-published 315 km/h and 12.8 L/100km WLTP combined; 4,691 lb curb.
cars.notes: The biggest tank in the class paired with the highest top speed.

cars.name: Toro Stregone LP400S
cars.sourceNote: 120L twin-tank confirmed by multiple sources; 174 mph/280 km/h; 1,370 kg dry; period 'sport driving' consumption figure (no combined-cycle rating exists for a 1979 car).
cars.notes: The exact black movie car from the iconic opening scene.

cars.name: Cavallo 512 BR
cars.sourceNote: 100L tank, 314 km/h, 1,471 kg kerb all consistently sourced. Consumption: sources gave an implausibly low 11.8 L/100km for a 428 hp NA V12; used a period-realistic sustained-cruise figure instead and flagged the discrepancy.
cars.notes: Flat-twelve built for sustained autostrada cruising rather than for corners.

cars.name: Crossflag Ray Z6
cars.sourceNote: 18.5 gal tank, 3,666 lb curb, EPA 14 mpg combined -> L/100km. Top speed 195 mph stock / 189 mph with the Z07 aero package (used the higher, unaero'd figure).
cars.notes: High-revving, mid-engine American speed that trades trunk space for raw track performance.

cars.name: Zuffen 992 Turbo S
cars.sourceNote: 17.6 gal tank, 199 mph (320 km/h), 3,635 lb curb, 11.9 L/100km WLTP combined — all Porsche-published.
cars.notes: The definitive 'everyday supercar', crushing highway miles in any weather.

cars.name: Ramhorn Fieldsman Ambulance
cars.sourceNote: ESTIMATED, not fully sourced: 36-gal factory tank is real; a coachbuilt ambulance box has no published factory spec, so weight (base B300 ~4,900 lb + box/equipment) and top speed are period-typical engineering estimates, not found figures.
cars.notes: The definitive real-world and cinematic deception vehicle used to trick the police.

cars.name: Sierra Works C-35 Dually
cars.sourceNote: ESTIMATED, not fully sourced: 20-gal long-bed tank is real; no factory curb weight for the C-35 one-ton dually specifically was found, so weight and top speed are period-comparable estimates from the C/K30-C35 family.
cars.notes: The heavy-duty movie throwback built to smash through obstacles and take off-road shortcuts.

cars.name: Dearborn Regent Interceptor
cars.sourceNote: 19 gal tank, 4,101 lb curb, EPA 16/24 city/hwy weighted toward city patrol use; electronically limited to 119-129 mph depending on axle ratio, used 130 mph as representative.
cars.notes: The final, peak model year of the iconic cruiser.

cars.name: Ironmark V90 Crossroad
cars.sourceNote: 15.9 gal tank, 4,147 lb curb, 250 km/h, 8.7 L/100km WLTP combined — all consistently sourced.
cars.notes: A modern, invisible luxury wagon that highway patrol completely overlooks.

cars.name: Dearborn Colt GT
cars.sourceNote: 16 gal tank, 3,705 lb curb, EPA 18 mpg combined (manual) -> L/100km, 155 mph limiter.
cars.notes: A nod to the pandemic-era records, rear seats stripped for a huge fuel cell.

cars.name: Kure RZ-7
cars.sourceNote: 70L (18.5 gal US-spec) tank, 1,290 kg kerb, 233 km/h, 10.6 L/100km — all sourced.
cars.notes: A high-skill, lightweight rotary build that trades frequent stops for agility.

cars.name: Aichi Sovra Turbo
cars.sourceNote: 18.5 gal (70L) tank, 1,570 kg kerb, 254 km/h, city/highway consumption averaged to 12.4 L/100km — all sourced.
cars.notes: The legendary overbuilt inline-6 platform for extreme highway turbo builds.

cars.name: Crossflag Cambria ZL1
cars.sourceNote: 19 gal tank, 3,907 lb curb, EPA 16 mpg combined -> L/100km, 191 mph — all sourced.
cars.notes: Adaptive damping is what keeps the speed up on bad surfaces.

cars.name: Weissblau 535d
cars.sourceNote: 70L tank, 1,840 kg curb, 250 km/h, 5.6 L/100km factory combined — all sourced.
cars.notes: The efficiency benchmark. On a long race this is very hard to beat.

cars.name: Leaper XJ-R
cars.sourceNote: 88L (23.1 gal, 4.0L NA-market tank), 1,845 kg curb, 250 km/h, 12.6 L/100km combined — all sourced.
cars.notes: Supercharged sleeper. Comfortable at pace; reliability will not be kind to it.

cars.name: Meridian LS 400
cars.sourceNote: 22.5 gal (85L) tank, 1,764 kg curb, 241 km/h, 11.8 L/100km — all sourced.
cars.notes: Unremarkable at everything and immune to the thing that ends other people's races.

cars.name: Ampere S Tri-Motor
cars.sourceNote: 99 kWh battery, 368 mi (592 km) EPA range -> 16.7 kWh/100km, 2,241 kg curb, 198.8 mph (320 km/h) — all sourced.
cars.notes: Unmatched instant acceleration, forcing players to manage battery and rapid-charging stops.
